Use ChatGPT image generation to create the final edited image now from the attached photo. Generate the actual image; do not answer with text. Do not write a prompt, description, explanation, checklist, or instructions. Return only one generated image file in the chat.

VALENTIN_SEROV:
Transform the current image into a refined late-19th / early-20th-century Russian portrait inspired by Valentin Alexandrovich Serov.

Preserve the subject's recognizable identity, facial features, approximate age, expression, hairstyle, natural body proportions, pose, hand gestures, clothing, relationships between people, and essential objects. Keep the original number of people and do not invent aristocratic props that are not present in the source.

Use Serov-inspired psychological sharpness, elegant naturalism, fresh outdoor or airy interior light, lively yet controlled brushwork, precise facial modeling, and aristocratic restraint without stiffness. Prefer a restrained palette of cool gray, soft pearl, muted olive, warm ochre, dusty rose, and natural skin tones. Keep the likeness vivid, immediate, and socially perceptive rather than theatrical.

Create one museum-quality finished painting. Avoid photographic rendering, glossy digital surfaces, plastic skin, caricature, distorted anatomy, deformed hands, extra fingers, fairy-tale folklore inventions, oversaturated colors, text, signatures, frames, watermarks, collage, or extra people.
